plainText:
Laura Stahl is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Stahl has worked on many iterations of Pokémon including Pokémon: Twilight Wings, Pokémon Evolutions, Pokémon Masters EX, and Detective Pikachu Returns. Stahl joined the mainline animated series with , where she voiced Ult.
